long_biography.plain_text:
Epsilon Aviation grew from a Greek cargo carrier into an operator serving freight, private passengers and medical transport. Efstathiou founded the company and led it as chief executive. Approval as an air carrier in 2003 established the operating platform, while the addition of Learjet aircraft broadened its services beyond cargo across Greece, Cyprus, the Balkans and the Mediterranean.

His background bridges family shipping and independent aviation enterprise. After studying shipping in London and technical subjects in Switzerland, he held management and directorship roles spanning Piraeus, London and Hamburg. Those maritime interests sit alongside Epsilon, where his founder relationship and long-running leadership define his principal public business identity.
